lines.en: label kaorispecial40:
scene kaorischool1
: Sensei! I’m glad I caught you.
lines.zh: : Sensei！真高兴逮到你了。

lines.en: : Me too. Now I don’t have to think up a quirky or depressing anecdote to kick things off.
lines.zh: : 我也是。这样我就不用想什么古怪或者丧气的段子来开场了。

lines.en: : Also, what do you mean “caught me?” It’s the middle of the school day.
lines.zh: : 还有，什么叫「逮到你」？现在是上课时间啊。

lines.en: : Yes, but it’s also lunch time. And I was wondering if you’d like to maybe eat on the roof with me today.
lines.zh: : 是没错，可现在也是午休时间。我在想，你今天要不要跟我一起去天台吃饭。

lines.en: : Check back in a few months when the sky is all red and weird.
lines.zh: : 过几个月再问吧，等天空变得又红又怪的时候。

lines.en: scene kaorischool2
: If that was a joke relating to the apparent state of the world that I only just found out about the other day, I’m sorry to say I didn’t quite get it.
lines.zh: : 如果那是关于世界现状的玩笑 —— 而我前几天才知道这回事 —— 那我很遗憾地说，我没太听懂。

lines.en: : That’s fine, Makoto. You’re a genius and talented and amazing and beautiful and you don’t need to know {i}everything{/i} to be the perfect girl we all know you are.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Makoto。你聪明、有才华、了不起又漂亮，而且你不需要{i}什么{/i}都知道，也能是我们都认识的那个完美女孩。

lines.en: : Look at me. I’m nice now.
lines.zh: : 看看我。我现在很温柔了。

lines.en: scene kaorischool3
: Yeah, {i}too{/i} nice. And it’s making me extremely uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 是啊，温柔{i}过头{/i}了。让我浑身不自在。

lines.en: : I figured if I got it all out of the way now that it would be fine to just speak normally for the rest of the day and not have to worry about complimenting you.
lines.zh: : 我想，要是把这些一次性说完，接下来一整天就能正常说话，也不用惦记着夸你了。

lines.en: : It’s really impressive how you can still manage to be an asshole while showering me with compliments.
lines.zh: : 你一边狂夸我一边还能当个混蛋，真是了不起。

lines.en: : My bad. There’s just a lot going on right now.
lines.zh: : 我的错。只是最近事情太多了。

lines.en: scene kaorischool4
: True. But, on the bright side, none of it matters anymore since we’re all just going revert back to earlier on in the school year anyway! Isn’t that great?!
lines.zh: : 没错。不过往好处想，这些都不重要了，反正我们马上就要回到这学年早些时候的样子了！这不是很棒吗？！

lines.en: : Sensei? Isn’t that great?
lines.zh: : Sensei？这不是很棒吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. So great.
lines.zh: : 是啊。棒极了。

lines.en: scene kaorischool5
: Okay, so {i}maybe{/i} I’ve still got a way to go before I catch up to your apocalypse humor. But, I’d be open to hearing you out about how much it’s been weighing you down.
lines.zh: : 好吧，{i}也许{/i}我离你的末日幽默还差得远。不过我愿意听听看，这件事让你有多沉重。

lines.en: : I might not be able to {i}fully{/i} relate, but I can guarantee you there’s a lot going on in my head that I’m still-
lines.zh: : 我可能没法{i}完全{/i}感同身受，但我可以保证，我脑子里也有很多事，我还——

lines.en: : It’s not even about that. It’s about everything else.
lines.zh: : 根本不是那回事。是别的一切。

lines.en: scene kaorischool6
: Like what? If you want to talk, now’s the time to do it since everyone else is in the cafeteria.
lines.zh: : 比如什么？如果你想聊，现在正是时候，其他人都去食堂了。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, I’ve been in a very talkative mood lately. So go ahead and pull up a chair since you're about to hear my entire life story.
lines.zh: : 你运气不错，我最近特别想说话。搬张椅子过来吧，因为你马上要听到我这辈子的全部故事了。

lines.en: : Or...at least all the parts of it that I can remember.
lines.zh: : 或者……至少是我还记得的那些部分。

lines.en: scene kaorischool7
: It all started one fateful hot boy summer-
lines.zh: : 一切都要从那个命运般的炎炎夏日说起——

lines.en: : Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 再见！

lines.en: scene kaorischool8
: Knock times two.
lines.zh: : 敲了两下门。

lines.en: : Who...is there?
lines.zh: : 谁……在那儿？

lines.en: : Me! I have arrived.
lines.zh: : 我！我到了。

lines.en: : And...you are?
lines.zh: : 还有……你是？

lines.en: : Kaori, what are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene kaorischool9
: I need help sitting on a child!
lines.zh: : 我需要帮忙坐在一个小孩上！

lines.en: : You what?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: scene kaorischool10
: Hah...Makoto, go eat in the cafeteria with everyone else. We can hang out on the roof tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 哈……Makoto，去食堂跟大家一起吃吧。天台我们明天再去。

lines.en: : What? Just like that? You’re going to walk away from me to help some college student sit on a child? {i}Why?{/i} And {i}what child?{/i}
lines.zh: : 什么？就这样？你要丢下我，去帮某个大学生坐在一个小孩上？{i}为什么{/i}？{i}什么{/i}小孩？

lines.en: : Kaori is definitely not a college student. In fact, she might not even be human. So do yourself a favor and stay as far away from us as possible until I tell you it’s safe to come back.
lines.zh: : Kaori 绝对不是大学生。事实上，她可能都不是人类。所以帮自己一个忙，离我们越远越好，等我告诉你安全了再回来。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: scene black
: Kaori, come on. I have no idea what you’re doing here. But if we’re going to talk, it should be in my-
lines.zh: : Kaori，走吧。我真不知道你在这儿干什么。但我们要谈的话，应该在我的——

lines.en: scene kaorischool11
: ...office.
lines.zh: : ……办公室里。

lines.en: scene kaorischool12
: Kaori, what do you think you’re doing bringing Nao here? She’s a missing child. Probably. If anyone is looking for her, you could go to jail.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你把 Nao 带到这儿来想干什么？她是个失踪儿童。大概吧。要是有人在找她，你可是会坐牢的。

lines.en: : Today, Nao-chan learns about human school! Where humans go to school! The place where knowledge happens and where Friend lives!
lines.zh: : 今天，Nao 酱要学习人类的学校！人类上学的地方！知识发生的地方，也是朋友住的地方！

lines.en: : I don’t {i}live{/i} here, I {i}work{/i} here. And I figured you’d understand that on account of the ten thousand jobs you have.
lines.zh: : 我不是{i}住{/i}在这儿，我是在这儿{i}工作{/i}。我还以为你能理解呢，毕竟你自己也有一万份工作。

lines.en: scene kaorischool13
: Nao-chan, the outward mouth vibrations that Friend threw up mean that he is glad that we are here!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱，朋友吐出来的那些向外的嘴巴震动，意思是他很高兴我们在这儿！

lines.en: : No they don’t. Go home.
lines.zh: : 不是的。回家去。

lines.en: scene kaorischool14
: But it was difficult enough riding the school-colored landboat and the next one does not arrive for another 7,800 seconds! We have nowhere else to exist!
lines.zh: : 可是坐那辆学校色的陆地船已经够难了，下一辆还要 7,800 秒才来！我们没有别的地方可以存在！

lines.en: : Kaori-
lines.zh: : Kaori——

lines.en: : I need help sitting on the child! Tell him, Nao-chan!
lines.zh: : 我需要帮忙坐在小孩上！你告诉他，Nao 酱！

lines.en: : She’s still not talking?
lines.zh: : 她还是不说话吗？

lines.en: scene kaorischool15
: She does struggle with her mouth muscle, but she is easy to understand when you can see the colors floating behind her tiny human body.
lines.zh: : 她的嘴巴肌肉确实不太好使，但只要你看见她小小身体后面漂浮的颜色，就很容易明白她的意思。

lines.en: : Great. Then, can you tell me what clear means?
lines.zh: : 很好。那么，你能告诉我「clear」是什么意思吗？

lines.en: scene kaorischool16
: Clear means special. It is the color or lack of color assigned to you on my talk-machine. But Nao-chan is not clear. She is purple.
lines.zh: : Clear 就是特别。那是我给你的、在我的说话机器上被分配的颜色 —— 或者说是没有颜色。但 Nao 酱不是 clear。她是紫色。

lines.en: : Well, whatever she is, let’s get her into my office. Lunch break will be ending soon and I don’t want to know what any of the girls would think if they saw me with two people who don’t even go here.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管她是什么，先把她弄进我办公室。午休快结束了，我可不想知道那些女孩看到我跟两个根本不是这儿的人在一起会怎么想。

lines.en: : But I have encountered many of your smaller female companions before. At what point will Nao-chan be tall enough to enlist as a Friend-friend?
lines.zh: : 可我以前见过你很多个更小的女性同伴。Nao 酱要长到多高，才能应征成为朋友的朋友？

lines.en: scene black
: Office. Now.
lines.zh: : 办公室。现在。

lines.en: : Ahh! Do not slow-run at such a jogging pace! Your lower meat-tubes are stronger and larger than the ones that belong to us!
lines.zh: : 啊！别用这种慢跑的速度慢——跑！你下面的肉管子比我们的更强壮也更大！

lines.en: Having absolutely no idea what’s going on (yet again), I quickly make my way through the halls before shoving the two {i}trespassers{/i} inside.
lines.zh: 我（又一次）完全搞不清状况，快步穿过走廊，然后把这两个{i}擅闯者{/i}塞了进去。

lines.en: scene kaorischool17
The one I’m already familiar with has no trouble accepting that she’s done something wrong and presses herself up against my desk.
lines.zh: 那个我已经熟悉的，很坦然地接受了「自己做错了事」这一点，把自己贴在我的办公桌边。

lines.en: The other one, however, begins to pick up objects all over the room and observe them.
lines.zh: 另一个则开始把房间里所有东西一件件拿起来端详。

lines.en: As you can see...right now, she is particularly fascinated by a mug.
lines.zh: 你也看到了……这会儿，她对一只马克杯格外着迷。

lines.en: There is nothing {i}in{/i} the mug. It’s just a mug.
lines.zh: 杯子{i}里{/i}什么都没有。就是个马克杯。

lines.en: And it’s such a strange and unnecessary thing to be doing that I’m just going to talk to Kaori while pretending she doesn’t exist.
lines.zh: 这举动又奇怪又没必要，所以我打算就当她不存在，直接跟 Kaori 说话。

lines.en: scene kaorischool18
: I have sat on so many babies recently that I do not know if I will ever sit again, Friend.
lines.zh: : 我最近坐在这么多宝宝上，都不知道自己还能不能再坐了，朋友。

lines.en: : If you’re referring to {i}actually{/i} sitting on babies, stop. But if you’re referring to {i}babysitting,{/i} I’m not sure what the issue is. Nao barely speaks.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的是{i}真的{/i}坐在宝宝身上，赶紧停下。但如果你说的是{i}照看{/i}小孩，我不明白有什么问题。Nao 基本上不说话。

lines.en: scene kaorischool19
: The tissue is-
lines.zh: : 这个纸巾是——

lines.en: : {i}Issue.{/i}
: Bless you. But anyway, the tissue is that mothering the hood is difficult no matter what size the hood is!
lines.zh: : 一百岁。总之，纸巾就是 —— 不管兜帽有多大，给它当妈都很难！

lines.en: : Nao-chan may have a small hood, but if I mother it wrong, the fabrics will become loose and she will have {i}no{/i} hood at all! Everything is up to me and it makes the “sleep” like a rock but not a sleep rock.
lines.zh: : Nao 酱的兜帽也许很小，可要是我当妈当错了，布料就会松掉，她就一个兜帽都{i}没有{/i}了！一切都落在我身上，这让我睡得像块石头，但又不是能睡着的石头。
: 所以……

lines.en: : What you’re saying is that you’re struggling with motherhood and worry that you’re going to do something wrong that might mess up the girl you kidnapped?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你在当妈这件事上手足无措，还担心自己做错什么、把那个你拐来的女孩给毁了？

lines.en: scene kaorischool20
: She is the good girl. And so very interested in round things and other things that are {i}not{/i} round but also shiny.
lines.zh: : 她是个好女孩。而且对圆的东西、还有那些{i}不圆{/i}但会发光的东西特别感兴趣。

lines.en: : I went as distant as opening the mothering hood book to learn the secrets of the mothermom. But many of the motherers can not come to an agreement on which hood I’m meant to mother. Or mom.
lines.zh: : 我甚至远到去翻开了「当妈兜帽手册」，想学会妈妈妈妈的秘密。可是很多当妈的人都说不出个准信 —— 我到底该当哪个兜帽的妈。或者妈妈。

lines.en: scene kaorischool21
: I do not know what to do, Friend.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么办，朋友。

lines.en: : I mean...you can start by...{i}returning{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你可以先……把她{i}还回去{/i}。

lines.en: : To where? Nao-chan has no family or burgerfriends. And all of the papers that remind her of who she is are as hidden as the Bigfeet.
lines.zh: : 还到哪儿去？Nao 酱没有家人，也没有堡朋友。而所有能让她想起自己是谁的纸，都藏得像大脚怪一样。

lines.en: : Do you mean...Bigfoot?
lines.zh: : 你是说……大脚怪？

lines.en: : Yes. The Bigfeet. Nowhere to be found and without sockpockets.
lines.zh: : 对。大脚怪。哪儿都找不到，连袜子口袋都没有。

lines.en: : It’s Big{i}foot,{/i} Kaori. Not Bigfeet.
lines.zh: : 是 Big{i}foot{/i}，Kaori。不是 Bigfeet。

lines.en: : Is only one of them large?
lines.zh: : 只有一只的脚大吗？

lines.en: : No, they’re both-
lines.zh: : 不，两只都——

lines.en: scene kaorischool22
: Wait, yeah. Why is it called that?
lines.zh: : 等等，对啊。为什么叫这个名字？

lines.en: : You non-Kaori humans are so very non-Kaori. If everyone were also a spider, it would make the world a lot easier to understand. But also there would be webs everywhere, which could get sticky.
lines.zh: : 你们这些非 Kaori 的人类真是太不 Kaori 了。要是所有人都是蜘蛛，这个世界就好懂得多了。不过那样到处都会是网，还可能黏糊糊的。

lines.en: scene kaorischool23
: Kaori, I don’t know what you want me to do. I have no idea how to help you with Nao and if you can’t take care of her, just find someone else who can.
lines.zh: : Kaori，我不知道你想让我做什么。我完全不知道该怎么帮你带 Nao，如果你照顾不了她，就找个能照顾的人吧。

lines.en: : Will you accept the role as her fatherdad? The mothering hood book told me to provide one and you’re the only non-chicken cock I know.
lines.zh: : 你愿意担任她的爸爸爸吗？那本当妈兜帽手册说要给她准备一个，而你是我认识的唯一一个不是鸡的鸡巴。

lines.en: : Don’t objectify me in my office. I’m more than just my best feature.
lines.zh: : 别在我办公室里物化我。我不止有我最好的那一部分。

lines.en: : Your best feature is your pointy chin. It’s so sharp and capable of causing harm to your adversaries.
lines.zh: : 你最好的部分是你的尖下巴。它那么锋利，能对你的敌人造成伤害。

lines.en: : I bet it could pop a sphere of thin, air-filled plastic.
lines.zh: : 我打赌它能戳破一个薄薄的、充了气的塑料球。

lines.en: scene kaorischool24
: Well, now I’m just self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 这下我都不好意思了。

lines.en: scene kaorischool25
: Sensei, what on earth is going on?! Who was that girl who-
lines.zh: : Sensei，到底在搞什么？！刚才那个女孩是谁——

lines.en: scene kaorischool26
scene kaorischool27
: Wooooow. Cool mug.
lines.zh: : 哇——哦。好酷的杯子。

lines.en: scene kaorischool28
: Sensei, what is happening right now? Who is this person? And {i}that{/i} person?
lines.zh: : Sensei，现在到底在发生什么？这个人是谁？还有{i}那个{/i}人？

lines.en: : And, before you answer, please just tell me they’re relatives of yours.
lines.zh: : 还有，在你回答之前，请直接告诉我她们是你的亲戚。

lines.en: : I am Kaori! The Queen of Spiders, Mistress of the Dark, and greatest waitress in Kumon-mi! And the tiny  human with the ceramic coffee-holder is called Nao-chan.
lines.zh: : 我是 Kaori！蜘蛛女王、黑暗女王、Kumon-mi 最伟大的女服务员！而那个拿着陶瓷咖啡容器的小小人类，叫做 Nao 酱。

lines.en: : And you are Sensei’s cousins...correct?
lines.zh: : 你们是 Sensei 的表亲……对吧？

lines.en: : Hey, remember earlier when I said that a lot has been happening lately? This is what I was talking about.
lines.zh: : 嘿，还记得我刚才说最近发生了很多事吗？我说的就是这个。

lines.en: scene black
scene kaorischool29
: So...let me get this straight.
lines.zh: : 那么……让我理一下。

lines.en: : A mysterious treasure map with nothing but a kanji character on it was taped to your door when you came home from work...
lines.zh: : 一张神秘的藏宝图，上面只有一个汉字，你下班回家时发现它被贴在你门上……

lines.en: : And so you went on a journey into the forest to {i}find{/i} that treasure...{i}didn’t{/i} find that treasure...but then proceeded to find {i}her{/i} instead...
lines.zh: : 于是你踏进森林去{i}寻找{/i}那件宝物……{i}没{/i}找到那件宝物……却反而找到了{i}她{/i}……

lines.en: : And so, instead of reporting a missing person to the police...you kidnapped her...and now you two are peacefully living together as...sisters? Friends?
lines.zh: : 于是，你没有向警方报失踪人口……而是把她拐走了……现在你们两个和平地生活在一起，关系算是……姐妹？朋友？

lines.en: : They have an eight-foot chicken named John as well.
lines.zh: : 她们家还有一只八英尺高的鸡，叫 John。

lines.en: : Eight and a half. Very big cock.
lines.zh: : 八英尺半。非常大的鸡巴。

lines.en: : And...uhh...{i}Nao-chan{/i} was it? You’re okay with all of this? You’re not being held against your will?
lines.zh: : 还有……呃……你叫 {i}Nao 酱{/i}对吧？这一切你都没问题吗？你不是被强行扣留的吧？

lines.en: scene kaorischool30
: I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : Are you seriously just going to ignore the eight foot chicken? Because that should have been pretty alarming.
lines.zh: : 你真的打算无视那只八英尺高的鸡吗？那应该挺让人警觉的吧。

lines.en: : At this point, I’m not sure if anything would alarm me. This world is becoming less and less believable every single day.
lines.zh: : 到了这个地步，我不确定还有什么能让我警觉。这个世界一天比一天更不可信了。

lines.en: : And now you know why I’ve been so exhausted.
lines.zh: : 现在你知道我为什么这么累了吧。

lines.en: : Glasses girl, what is your relationship to the burger man? Has he put his fingers in your mouth before?
lines.zh: : 眼镜女孩，你和那个汉堡男人是什么关系？他以前把手指放进过你嘴里吗？

lines.en: scene kaorischool31
: Kaori, please never ask that question to anyone again.
lines.zh: : Kaori，以后请别再对任何人问这种问题了。

lines.en: : I...uhh...maybe? I can’t really remember, but...it’s possible?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……也许吧？我不太记得了，不过……有可能？

lines.en: : {i}Why wouldn't you just say no?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你为什么不直接说没有呢？……{/i}

lines.en: : I bet you can fit many hand-handles in your face opening. Accept this human compliment and tell your teacher-man to become Nao-chan’s fatherdad as thanks for my words of handcouragement.
lines.zh: : 我打赌你的脸开口能塞下很多把手柄。收下这句人类赞美，然后叫你的老师男人去当 Nao 酱的爸爸爸，就当是感谢我这些手的鼓励。

lines.en: : You...want him to help you raise the girl you kidnapped? As mother and father?
lines.zh: : 你……想让他帮你抚养你拐来的那个女孩？当妈和当爸？

lines.en: : Correct!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: : Friend is reliable and kind and would make an excellent fatherdad for Nao-chan! She already loves him very much!
lines.zh: : 朋友可靠又温柔，会是个非常出色的爸爸爸！她已经非常喜欢他了！

lines.en: : She does?
lines.zh: : 她喜欢吗？

lines.en: scene kaorischool32
: What if I promise you all of the cream in the worldglobe? Or free sausage fests for the rest of your life? Or all of the hot meat you could ever want?
lines.zh: : 如果我把全世界的奶油都许给你呢？或者让你一辈子免费参加香肠节？或者给你想要多少就有多少的热肉？

lines.en: : Kaori, I get that you’re worried, but I’m pretty sure Nao will be fine. She’s not a toddler. She’s old enough to, like...function as an actual human for the most part.
lines.zh: : Kaori，我知道你担心，但我很确定 Nao 不会有事。她又不是刚学走路的小孩。她已经大到……基本上能像个真正的人那样生活了。

lines.en: : Just focus on teaching her all of the things she doesn’t know for now. Once she starts seeming like less of a kid to you, I’m sure some of those worries will start to fade.
lines.zh: : 现在就专心教她那些她不懂的事吧。等她在你眼里不那么像个小孩了，我相信这些担心就会慢慢淡掉。

lines.en: scene kaorischool33
: How come she gets actual advice when all {i}I{/i} ever get is inappropriate touching?
lines.zh: : 为什么她能得到真正的建议，而{i}我{/i}得到的从来都只是被乱摸？

lines.en: : But what if I can not effectively mom? I do not even have a hood. What am I supposed to drape over her head-bone when the coldness comes in?
lines.zh: : 可要是我当不好妈呢？我连个兜帽都没有。寒冷进来的时候，我该拿什么盖在她那根头骨上？

lines.en: : Motherhood doesn’t involve an actual {i}hood,{/i} Kaori. If you’re that insistent on keeping her, just do what I said and things will work out fine.
lines.zh: : 当妈不需要真的{i}兜帽{/i}，Kaori。你既然这么想留下她，就照我说的做，事情会好起来的。

lines.en: : I’m not going to just step in and be her dad, though. That’s weird.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会就这么跳进去当她爸的。那太奇怪了。

lines.en: : Is it weird because you did not create her with your sperms?
lines.zh: : 奇怪是因为你不是用你的精子造出她的吗？

lines.en: : You know, maybe our class isn’t so weird after all if this is who you’re talking to outside of it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，如果你在课外聊天的对象是这种人，那我们班也许根本不算奇怪。

lines.en: : It’s weird because I barely know her and didn’t sign up for a daughter when I already have Ami and a million other girls I’m supposed to be taking care of.
lines.zh: : 奇怪是因为我几乎不认识她，而且我已经有 Ami、还有一百万个我该照顾的女孩了，我可没报名再添一个女儿。

lines.en: scene kaorischool34
: Wow, are you actually planning on looking after us now? Or are you just saying that to weasel yourself out of this situation?
lines.zh: : 哇，你现在是真的打算照顾我们了吗？还是说你只是想用这话脱身？

lines.en: : You’re not helping, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你这是在帮倒忙，Makoto。

lines.en: : You want me to help? Here. I’ll help.
lines.zh: : 你想让我帮忙？行。我来帮。

lines.en: scene kaorischool35
: Sensei and I will raise Nao-chan together. That way, you can go back to focusing on...whatever it is you do while not having to worry about her anymore. Easy fix, right?
lines.zh: : 我和 Sensei 会一起抚养 Nao 酱。这样你就可以回去专心做……你平时做的那些事，不用再担心她了。简单的解决办法，对吧？

lines.en: : Together?...
: Makoto, that might be easy for {i}Kaori,{/i} but not us. You can't just sign me up for things like this.
lines.zh: : Makoto，这对 {i}Kaori{/i} 来说也许轻松，但对我们不是。你不能就这么替我报名做这种事。

lines.en: : Why not? We’re basically married already.
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？我们基本上已经结婚了。

lines.en: : Not by any choice of mine we’re not.
lines.zh: : 反正不是我选的。

lines.en: : Does that work for you, Kaori? I can take her back to my house as soon as you leave.
lines.zh: : 这样你接受吗，Kaori？你一走，我就可以把她带回我家。

lines.en: scene kaorischool36
scene kaorischool37
: I DON’T WANT TO LEAVE NAO-CHAN BEHIND! I’LL BE A GOOD MOTHERMOM!!!!
lines.zh: : 我不想把 NAO 酱丢下！我会当一个好妈妈妈妈的！！！！

lines.en: : There. Problem solved.
lines.zh: : 好了。问题解决了。

lines.en: : Is it really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的解决了吗？

lines.en: scene kaorischool38
: For now, at least. It was clear from the start she never wanted to let her go. She’s just overwhelmed and having some doubts about her ability to provide adequate care.
lines.zh: : 至少眼下是。从一开始就很清楚，她根本没想过要放手。她只是被压垮了，对自己能不能好好照顾她有点动摇。

lines.en: : The thing is, people tend to whip themselves into shape once they’re threatened with the things they love being taken away. So I may have just saved a child. Go Makoto.
lines.zh: : 问题是，人一旦被威胁说要失去心爱的东西，往往就会逼自己振作起来。所以我可能刚救了一个小孩。干得好，Makoto。

lines.en: : Nao-chan! I am sorry for my momentary head clouds! I am just as lost as you were in the chicken alley! We can help each other become good human females! That is the promise we are making now!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱！对不起，我刚才脑子里飘过乌云！我和你当初在鸡肉小巷里一样迷路！我们可以互相帮助，成为优秀的人类女性！这就是我们现在许下的承诺！

lines.en: scene kaorischool39
: Thank you for providing the assistance, Friend! We could not have completed this without you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的帮助，朋友！没有你我们完成不了这件事！

lines.en: : Wait, seriously? He didn’t even do anything. I was the one who actually {i}helped.{/i} He just stood there and said no to a bunch of stuff.
lines.zh: : 等等，认真的？他什么都没做啊。真正{i}帮忙{/i}的是我。他就站在那儿，对一堆事情说不。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s not true. I did say that one thing about teaching her stuff — which I assume Kaori is going to do as soon as she gets home.
lines.zh: : 嘿，这可不属实。我确实说了教她东西那件事 —— 我猜 Kaori 一回家就会去做。

lines.en: scene kaorischool40
: Nao-chan, what do you want to learn?! I will teach you all of the knowledge in the human world in the order you want so long as the alphabet is not that involved in that order!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱，你想学什么？！我会按你想要的顺序，把人类世界的全部知识都教给你 —— 只要那个顺序里不怎么牵扯到字母表！

lines.en: : Then it is settled! Nao-chan will learn how to read!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了！Nao 酱要学会读书！

lines.en: scene kaorischool41
: Will you still bring your body to the building we live in?
lines.zh: : 你还会把你的身体带去我们住的那栋楼吗？

lines.en: : You do not have to fatherdad, but you can still make words happen and stroke the giant cock.
lines.zh: : 你不必当爸爸爸，但你还是可以说话，还可以摸那只巨大的鸡巴。

lines.en: : I’ll still come over, Kaori. Just...keep doing your best for the time being. Even if your “best” is entirely inadequate by most childcare standards. Probably. But I guess that’s an issue for another-
lines.zh: : 我还是会过去的，Kaori。只是……暂时继续尽力就好。就算你的「尽力」按大多数育儿标准来看完全不合格。大概吧。不过我想那就是另——

lines.en: : Bless you.
lines.zh: : 一百岁。

lines.en: scene black
: But I guess that’s a {i}tissue{/i} for another day...
lines.zh: : 不过我想，那就是另一天的{i}纸巾{/i}了……

lines.en: Kaori and Nao leave the office, but Makoto makes sure to stay behind and lecture me about getting myself involved with weird people.
lines.zh: Kaori 和 Nao 离开了办公室，但 Makoto 特意留下来，教训我一番别再跟怪人扯上关系。

lines.en: The thing is, {i}they’re{/i} kind of the ones who got themselves involved with me.
lines.zh: 问题是，明明是{i}她们{/i}自己主动缠上我的。

lines.en: Like...sure, I do call Kaori on occasion. But most of our important interactions have just been me bumping into her somewhere.
lines.zh: 比如……好吧，我确实偶尔会给 Kaori 打电话。但我们大多数重要的交集，都只是我在某个地方撞见她而已。

lines.en: Nao is no different.
lines.zh: Nao 也一样。

lines.en: Well, actually, Nao is {i}entirely{/i} different. But the way in which we met isn’t.
lines.zh: 好吧，其实 Nao {i}完全{/i}不同。但我们相遇的方式没什么不同。

lines.en: They’re just two weird girls I managed to encounter in my long, strange journey through a world that shouldn’t spin.
lines.zh: 她们只是我在这个本不该旋转的世界里、漫长而奇异的旅途中碰上的两个怪女孩。

lines.en: And I’m sure that world is even stranger for them.
lines.zh: 而我敢肯定，那个世界对她们来说更加奇怪。
